observations: Two nearly identical photos show a grid of paperback books laid out on a tiled floor.
Visible titles include The Compound Effect, This Is Marketing, The Millionaire Next Door, Zero One, Women Rise Up, Sell Like Crazy, The Psychology of Money, and How Europe Underdeveloped Africa.
Watermark "EDENBOOKSTORE POSTED ON JIJI" appears across both photos.
The books span business, self-help, motivation, and relationship categories.
No single brand or model; multiple authors and publishers are visible on the covers.

identity.kind: lot of second-hand self-help, business and relationship books

claims.claim: Motivational, business, relationship and self development books
claims.evidence: Visible titles in photo 0 and photo 1 match these categories.

risks.risk: Hidden damage such as water stains, mold, torn pages, heavy highlighting, or missing pages not visible from cover shots.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each book's pages, spine, and edges, or a video flipping through the lot.

risks.risk: The lot may be incomplete or missing books compared to what is shown.
risks.proof: A video showing the full lot from multiple angles with a clear count.

risks.risk: Copies may be pirated or counterfeit rather than genuine publisher editions.
risks.proof: Photos of copyright and title pages showing publisher and ISBN.
risks.if_unproven: as unverified or possibly counterfeit copies

risks.risk: Older editions with lower resale value cannot be ruled out.
risks.proof: Photos of copyright pages showing publication year.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of book spines and page edges to check condition.
Video flipping through a sample of books to confirm pages are intact.
Photos of copyright pages to verify editions and authenticity.
response.reason: The lot is identifiable as second-hand books from visible titles, so it can be priced at worst-case condition while condition proof is requested to raise value.
